note: BUMPED to 1.0.5 from 1.0.4. THE TRANSCRIPTION IS UNCHANGED: source.txt is byte-identical to 1.0.4’s (sha256 748e58cef10981193585a101fcf67951cc3a37577eaf756f08399e343e1dd8bf) and the division model is CARRIED UNCHANGED (divisions.json byte-identical), because this bump is about RULES AND EVIDENCE and nothing else. WHAT CHANGES IS THE RULES, AND IT IS A CORRECTION OF 1.0.4. 1.0.4 kept fourteen rules whose target the human-proofread witness does not read: at those points Project Gutenberg’s transcription of the same 1816 print reads the very form the rule changes away FROM, i.e. the print carries the form the rule altered. 1.0.4 classified those fourteen as EMENDATIONS OF THE PRINT and left the reading standing. RE-MEASURED for 1.0.5 against the only two positive tests that ask whether the print’s form is an ERROR, NONE of the fourteen fires: at every one of them the print’s own form is an ordinary word of the print’s OWN vocabulary and a form the print uses ELSEWHERE in its own text. So no measurement shows the print at fault, and the class was named after the conclusion it wanted. TWELVE of the rules therefore OVERRODE a print our transcription already reads and are WITHDRAWN — the version serves the print’s own text at those points (8574, 8599, 8611, 8619, 8672, 8683, 8906, 8944, 8995, 8996, 9015, 10291) — and THREE do real work on a damaged transcription with a WRONG TARGET, so the target is corrected to the print’s own words under a fresh id with the old id spent (r8961 -> “as in images the”; r9069 -> “inferior being”; r10120 -> “to united”). ALSO CORRECTED: the CLEARING BASIS was applied TWO ways. 1.0.4 cleared a TIGHT placement on the whole reading OR on the changed words alone, and a SLID placement only on the whole reading, so nine rules cleared on a basis the slid branch already refused. ONE basis now governs every placement — the witness must carry the rule’s WHOLE `after` reading — and those nine flags stand again (one of them, r8961, is the case whose target the witness’s own words refute; it is corrected as above). 1,265 clears become 1,256. AND THE TEST THAT WAS TRIED AND REJECTED IS NAMED WITH ITS NUMBERS, so the next unit need not re-propose it: the phrase-idiolect test fires for r8906 (whose print form is ITALICISED as a defined term and glossed with the Greek) and for r8619 (a determiner swap) and does not fire for the four a reader would defend.
